item.tib: klu rgyal ma nga mched gsum gyi zhu lan
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ yi ger btab pa bzod par gsol/ bka' srung 'phrag dogs mi mdzad zhu/ 'di bris dge ba rnam dag mthus/ bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can rnams/ bon nyid dbyings su sangs rgyas shog kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas nas/ mkha' la nyi shar bkra shis shog/
